phrase.zh: 把散页连起，让故事继续被翻阅。
phrase.en: Join the pages so a story can be read again.

visual.zh: 手、打开的书脊和层层书页把装订呈现为连接的动作。画面不是一本可识别古籍的修复记录，弯曲的纸页也不能当作具体装订步骤。
visual.en: Hands, an open spine and layered pages present binding as an act of connection. This is not a conservation record of an identified book, and the curved pages are not a step-by-step binding guide.

background.zh: 英国皇家收藏的《美洲鸟类》重装记录展示了书帖、缝线和衬页如何协同：各书帖按模板预先穿孔，再进行缝合。书籍因此不仅是文字，也是一种需要选择材料、控制结构的物件；修复方法要根据实际藏品决定。
background.en: The Royal Collection’s rebinding record for Birds of America shows sections, sewing and endpapers working together, with sections pre-pierced using a template. A book is thus a material structure as well as text. Conservation choices depend on the actual object rather than a universal recipe.

sources.label: Royal Collection Trust · Making sections, sewing and endpapers
